pageHeader.title: Users
pageHeader.description: The accounts that can sign in to this panel. Add one for anyone who needs their own login, then set what they can do from Roles & Permissions.

permissionDenied.title: You can't manage user accounts
permissionDenied.description: Your account's role doesn't include "Manage user accounts". Ask an administrator to grant it if you need access to this screen.

deleteDialog.title: Remove {{username}}?
deleteDialog.description: They will lose access to this panel immediately, on their very next request — not eventually. This can't be undone.

unlinkDialog.title: Unlink SSO from {{username}}?
unlinkDialog.description: Every SSO identity linked to this account is removed and the account is signed out everywhere. Password sign-in still works, and you can link SSO again.

createDialog.title: Add a user
createDialog.description: Create a login for someone else. They'll use this username and password to sign in.
createDialog.usernameHint: Use a local username, not an email address. Link Google/SSO after creating the account.
createDialog.roleTip: Sets what this account can do from the moment it signs in — the exact list of allowed actions lives in Roles & Permissions, not here. You can change it any time after creating the account, so a close guess is fine now.

toasts.userCreatedRoleAssignFailedDescription: {{username}} was created as "moderator", but assigning "{{role}}" failed: {{reason}}. Change it from Roles & Permissions.
toasts.ssoLinkedDescription: The external identity is now linked to this account.
toasts.ssoLinkExpired: The SSO linking session expired. Start the link again.
toasts.ssoLinkFailed: The SSO identity could not be linked to this account.
toasts.ssoLinkedDescriptionWithEmail: {{email}} is now linked to {{username}}. If that isn't their address, unlink it.
toasts.ssoUnlinkedDescription: {{username}} can no longer sign in with SSO and has been signed out everywhere.
toasts.signedOutDescription: {{username}} was signed out of every browser and device.

signOutDialog.title: Sign {{username}} out everywhere?
signOutDialog.description: Every browser and device signed in as this account is signed out. Its password and role stay the same.
